spot.html_text: This was von Wright’s proposed account of a continuous change in an ontology of intervals. The state ⟦M⟧ changes continuously to ⟦M⟧ if there is a preceding interval which is ⟦M⟧ throughout, then an interval with ⟦M⟧ and ⟦M⟧ dense in each other, then a succeeding interval with p holding throughout.
